selection_provenance: User supplied 2 FINVIZ screenshots of a screener and portfolio, selected tickers after observing displayed performance

test.reference_price: Last observed Alpaca IEX bar close on Nov12, not necessarily official consolidated closing price
test.tick: Price >=1 USD => 0.01 USD; below 1 USD => 0.0001 USD
test.confirmation: Two consecutive 5-minute closing IEX bars above trigger (must be exactly adjacent in clock) before any hypothesized buy
test.late_entry_cutoff: 2026-11-13T20:00:00Z (15:00 EST, allow at least one hour trading)
test.priced_entry: Next observed bar OPEN only as hypothetical proxy when between trigger and limit; no fills claimed
test.modeled_exit: Last observed 2026-11-13 IEX CLOSE (not 72h swing result)

falsifiers: 3%-4% positive touches also include realized losers
many gaps/last-minute IEX first crosses unobservable as liquid fills
positive result vanishes after cost stress or timing correction
selection after outcomes cannot certify alpha
forbid: pretend 5-minute IEX bars are complete SIP or NBBO
use future high to condition entering at previous close
report BUY stop touched as a broker fill
